records.title: ERNIE-DOC: The Retrospective Long-Document Modeling Transformer
records.reason: ERNIE-DOC is a document-level language pretraining model using retrospective feed and enhanced recurrence mechanisms to model complete long documents; a pretraining model for document tasks, not an inference system.

records.title: Adaptive Signal Resuscitation: Channel-wise Post-Pruning Repair for Sparse Vision Networks
records.reason: Adaptive Signal Resuscitation is a training-free channel-wise variance-matching repair applied after one-shot magnitude pruning of sparse vision networks; a vision-model compression repair, not LLM inference.

records.title: SummaryMixing: A Linear-Complexity Alternative to Self-Attention for Speech Recognition and Understanding
records.reason: SummaryMixing replaces self-attention with a single utterance summary plus time-specific information in ASR models, making speech recognition inference up to 28% faster; a speech-recognition application architecture.

records.title: Q-ASR: Integer-only Zero-shot Quantization for Efficient Speech Recognition
records.reason: Q-ASR is an integer-only zero-shot quantization scheme using synthetic calibration data, applied to QuartzNet/Jasper/Conformer for edge speech recognition; inference quantization bound to ASR models.

records.title: PARADE: Passage Representation Aggregation forDocument Reranking
records.reason: Compares passage representation aggregation strategies (PARADE) for BERT/T5 document reranking on Robust04/GOV2; an information-retrieval task study.

records.title: MMSegRWKV: Enhancing Multimodal MRI Segmentation for Internet-of-Medical-Things-Enabled Healthcare With RWKV-Inspired Architectures
records.reason: Title explicitly presents multimodal MRI segmentation for Internet-of-Medical-Things healthcare, a medical imaging application.

records.title: HiRID-ICU-Benchmark - A Comprehensive Machine Learning Benchmark on High-resolution ICU Data
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a machine learning benchmark on high-resolution ICU data, a clinical/healthcare benchmark application.

records.title: Online portfolio management via deep reinforcement learning with high-frequency data
records.reason: Title explicitly concerns online portfolio management via deep reinforcement learning with high-frequency data, a financial application.

records.title: Federated Split BERT for Heterogeneous Text Classification
records.reason: FedSplitBERT splits BERT encoder layers between clients and a server for federated text classification under non-IID data, using quantization to cut communication; federated training, not inference.

records.title: Graph-tree Fusion Model with Bidirectional Information Propagation for Long Document Classification
records.reason: Fuses syntax-tree sentence encodings with document graph attention for long document classification without token limits; a document-classification task model.

records.title: Graph Masked Autoencoder
records.reason: Graph Masked Autoencoders learn graph representations by reconstructing masked node features with an asymmetric transformer encoder-decoder; self-supervised graph learning, not inference systems.

records.title: DMS-SVDD: Dynamic Multiscale State-Space Support Vector Data Description for Lithium-Ion Battery Fault Detection from Electric Vehicle Charging Segments
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a state-space data-description method for lithium-ion battery fault detection from EV charging segments, a battery/EV application.

records.title: Finding Change in Satellite Archives from Text: How to Combine Before-and-After Images Efficiently
records.reason: Title explicitly concerns finding change in satellite archives from text, a remote-sensing/satellite application.

records.title: Generalized Correctness Models: Learning Calibrated and Model-Agnostic Correctness Predictors from Historical Patterns
records.reason: Generalized Correctness Models learn calibrated predictors of LLM answer correctness from many models historical outputs; a confidence-estimation study, not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: An Efficient Coarse-to-Fine Facet-Aware Unsupervised Summarization Framework Based on Semantic Blocks
records.reason: C2F-FAR is a coarse-to-fine facet-aware ranking framework for unsupervised long-document summarization over semantic blocks; a summarization task framework.

records.title: Improving Legal Judgement Prediction in Romanian with Long Text Encoders
records.reason: Title explicitly concerns improving legal judgement prediction in Romanian with long text encoders, a legal application.

records.title: Machine Learning Predictors for Min-Entropy Estimation
records.reason: Shows machine learning predictors (CNN-LSTM, GPT-2) estimate average min-entropy of random number generators, outperforming NIST SP 800-90B predictors in some settings; a cryptographic entropy-estimation study.

records.title: Halveformer: A Novel Architecture Combined with Linear Models for Long Sequences Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: Halveformer combines linear models with a transformer encoder for long-sequence time series forecasting on seven benchmarks; a forecasting architecture.

records.title: Local Masked Reconstruction for Efficient Self-Supervised Learning on High-Resolution Images
records.reason: Local masked reconstruction makes generative self-supervised vision pretraining 2.5x faster than MAE on high-resolution ImageNet; a vision pretraining method (same LoMaR line as the related pretraining paper).

records.title: Transferable Sequential Recommendation with Vanilla Cross-Entropy Loss
records.reason: MMM4Rec is a multimodal Mamba framework with algebraic constraints for transferable sequential recommendation; a recommender-systems application.

records.title: MoEfication: Conditional Computation of Transformer Models for Efficient Inference
records.reason: MoEfication splits pretrained transformer FFN parameters into functional expert partitions with learned routers, conditionally using only 10-30% of FFN parameters while keeping over 95% of original performance, directly enabling efficient inference.

records.title: EdgePrompt: A Distributed Key-Value Inference Framework for LLMs in 6G Networks
records.reason: EdgePrompt is a cloud-edge collaborative framework using hierarchical attention splicing and distributed key-value pair optimization to raise LLM inference throughput and cut latency in 6G network deployments.

records.title: Cooperative Memory Paging with Keyword Bookmarks for Long-Horizon LLM Conversations
records.reason: Cooperative memory paging replaces evicted conversation segments with 8-24 token keyword bookmarks and gives the model a recall tool, beating full context on LoCoMo across four models; a KV/context memory management scheme for long-horizon LLM conversations.

records.title: AUE: A Normalized Energy Efficiency Metric for AI Servers Under LLM Workloads
records.reason: Proposes AUE, a normalized energy-efficiency metric (energy per thousand tokens per billion activated parameters) measured on Ascend NPU servers under dense and MoE LLM workloads; inference-infrastructure measurement, not a serving mechanism.

records.title: Small Clips, Big Gains: Learning Long-Range Refocused Temporal Information for Video Super-Resolution
records.reason: LRTI-VSR is a training framework that teaches recurrent video super-resolution models to exploit long-range refocused temporal information from short training clips; a video restoration task method.

records.title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders
records.reason: Designs a looped causal encoder-decoder whose encoder recurrence shares the last round KV cache losslessly, achieving zero round-wise KV growth and 1/6 of a looped transformer global KV, validated by looping the 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash for serving.

records.title: AutoNeural: Co-Designing Vision-Language Models for NPU Inference
records.reason: AutoNeural co-designs an NPU-native VLM: a MobileNetV5-style encoder with bounded activations for stable INT4/8/16 integer-only inference and an SSM-hybrid language backbone that removes KV-cache memory I/O during generation.

records.title: PagedMoE: Cross-Precision Expert Caching for Token-Level Dynamic Precision in SSD-Resident MoE Inference
records.reason: PagedMoE stores each SSD-resident MoE expert once in a prefix-compatible tree codebook and bitplane layout so lower-precision prefixes are reused or extended by fetching only missing bitplanes, cutting SSD I/O in token-level dynamic-precision expert caching.

records.title: Macformer: Transformer with Random Maclaurin Feature Attention
records.reason: Macformer approximates dot-product kernels with random Maclaurin features for linear-time attention, validated mainly on the Long Range Arena benchmark; a generic efficient-attention architecture without an LLM serving evaluation.

records.title: Breaking the Bottlenecks: Scalable Diffusion Models for 3D Molecular Generation
records.reason: Reinterprets directly denoising diffusion models through a reverse transition kernel formalism for 3D molecular generation; a molecular-generation theory/application paper.

records.title: State Space Models for Bioacoustics: A comparative Evaluation with Transformers
records.reason: Title explicitly evaluates state space models for bioacoustics against transformers, an animal-sound/biological audio application domain.

records.title: Long-Lived Characters, Local Inference: Incremental Memory Maintenance for Game NPCs
records.reason: Studies incremental memory maintenance for long-lived game NPCs on a local quantized hybrid recurrent-attention model, removing superseded attention KV entries and recomputing replacements at the sequence tail; the KV-cache maintenance mechanism is application-bound and evaluated only in local experiments.

records.title: HieraMamba: Video Temporal Grounding via Hierarchical Anchor-Mamba Pooling
records.reason: HieraMamba uses hierarchical anchor-Mamba pooling with contrastive objectives for video temporal grounding on Ego4D-NLQ/MAD/TACoS; a video localization task architecture.

records.title: KV Cache Recycling to Expand Usable Context Capacity in Low Parameter LLMs
records.reason: KV cache recycling serializes past key-value activations to CPU and reuses them when a cached prompt is an exact prefix of a new input, giving consistent latency speedups with no material output degradation in DialoGPT-medium tests.

records.title: Task Offloading for Collaborative Inference of LLM Agents at the Network Edge
records.reason: Proposes a two-stage optimization of task offloading decisions and compute resource allocation for collaborative inference of LLM agents at the network edge, reducing total task completion latency by 49.6% versus random, greedy and genetic baselines.

records.title: FlashSVD v1.5: Making Low-Rank Transformers Inference Actually Fast
records.reason: FlashSVD v1.5 is a unified inference runtime for SVD-compressed transformers combining phase-specific kernels, dense-KV decode, packed MLP execution and per-layer CUDA-graph replay, achieving up to 2.55x decode and 2.39x end-to-end speedup.

records.title: Folding Attention: Memory and Power Optimization for On-Device Transformer-Based Streaming Speech Recognition
records.reason: Folding attention shrinks the linear projection layers dominating on-device streaming speech recognition transformers, cutting model size 24% and power 23%; a general compression trick evaluated only on a speech application.

records.title: Kafila: Serving Large Language Models on a Trusted Set of Heterogeneous Commodity Machines
records.reason: Kafila serves LLMs across a trusted ring of heterogeneous commodity machines, with a planner that measures each device memory bandwidth and capacity and divides the model exactly for the fixed ring order before serving begins.

records.title: Do You Really Need a GPU to Guard Your LLM? CPU-Class Classifiers and Multi-Stage Pipelines for Safety Enforcement at Scale
records.reason: Evaluates CPU-class TF-IDF classifiers against GPU transformer pipelines for jailbreak safety screening of LLM traffic at deployment scale and cost; guardrail infrastructure evaluation adjacent to, but not part of, core LLM inference.

records.title: Accelerating Transformers with Spectrum-Preserving Token Merging
records.reason: PiToMe merges tokens using an energy score that preserves informative low-energy tokens, reducing transformer computational and memory requirements while maintaining accuracy across vision and language models including GPT and LLaVA.

records.title: MipKV: A Sparsify-Then-Recover Paradigm for Accelerating Large Vision-Language Model Pre-Filling
records.reason: MipKV downsamples visual tokens into offset thumbnails, prunes cross-thumbnail attention and selectively recomputes high-deviation tokens, accelerating LVLM pre-filling to 16.25% of self-attention FLOPs with 7.45x faster attention on Qwen2-VL.
